standard.summary: 控制 SafeGuard 梯度异常扫描的 CUDA 同步策略：batched（批量检查，最少同步）/ foreach（遍历检查）/ legacy（逐参数，最多同步）/ off（关闭梯度扫描）。
standard.effect: batched 模式 CUDA 同步次数最少（约 1~2 次/步），overhead 最低；legacy 每参数一次同步，老显卡兼容性最好；off 完全跳过梯度范数检查。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 batched 适合现代显卡（Ampere+）。老显卡（Maxwell/Pascal）遇到 batched 报错时改为 legacy。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议 off（关闭后梯度爆炸检测失效）。

optionDescriptions.batched: 梯度拼一批查 NaN/Inf，同步最少。

standard_en.summary: Controls the CUDA synchronisation strategy of SafeGuard's gradient-anomaly scan: batched (checks in bulk, the fewest syncs) / foreach (checks by iteration) / legacy (per parameter, the most syncs) / off (gradient scanning disabled).
standard_en.effect: batched syncs CUDA the fewest times (roughly 1~2 per step) and has the lowest overhead; legacy syncs once per parameter and has the best compatibility with old cards; off skips the gradient-norm check entirely.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default batched suits modern cards (Ampere and later). Switch to legacy if an old card (Maxwell/Pascal) errors out on batched.
standard_en.avoidWhen: off is not recommended (with it off, gradient-explosion detection stops working).

optionDescriptions.batched: Gradients are checked for NaN/Inf as one batch, with the fewest syncs.
optionDescriptions.foreach: Scans with foreach, a moderate number of syncs.
optionDescriptions.legacy: Scans one parameter at a time, the slowest.

advanced.principle: batched = 将所有参数梯度 concat 后一次性检查 NaN/Inf（一次 CUDA 同步）；foreach = 使用 torch._foreach_* 向量化遍历（约 2~3 次同步）；legacy = for 循环逐参数检查（参数量次同步）。
advanced.tradeoffs: batched 需要暂时将所有梯度 concat（额外显存峰值）；legacy 同步多但不需要额外内存。

advanced_en.principle: batched = concatenates all parameters' gradients and checks NaN/Inf in one shot (one CUDA sync); foreach = vectorized traversal via torch._foreach_* (about 2~3 syncs); legacy = a for-loop checking parameter by parameter (one sync per parameter).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: batched needs to temporarily concat all gradients (extra VRAM peak); legacy syncs a lot but needs no extra memory.
